title: Unable to Remove MCP Server Using CLI Command
body:
**Bug Description**
Impossible to remove mcp server. Running `claude mcp get <name>` works as expected, but `claude mcp remove <name>` does not find it (`No local mcp server found with name: <name>`)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3b3eeaa4-1d7a-4273-b78d-938a117621cd)

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: cursor
